title: RMTP v0.3 Replication Revocation Receipt
description: Records a claimed or independently verified revocation affecting bounded replicated AI agent instances. Revocation does not prove termination, retirement, or resource release.

revocation_id.description: Unique identifier for this revocation receipt.

authority_ref.description: Reference to the authority envelope being revoked.

plan_ref.description: Reference to the affected replication plan.

affected_offspring_ids.description: Identifiers of offspring affected by this revocation. Every identifier must resolve to the referenced replication plan.

issuer_id.description: Principal or control service issuing the revocation. Actual authorization must be verified externally.

effective_at.description: Timestamp at which revocation becomes effective.

recorded_at.description: Timestamp when the revocation receipt was recorded.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence references supporting the revocation event.

termination_required.description: Revocation of an active replication authority requires affected active instances to undergo termination handling. This is not proof that termination occurred.

verification_status.description: Verification status of the revocation record, not the termination status of affected instances.

verification_ref.description: Reference to independent verification of the revocation.

verification_method.description: Method claimed for verifying the revocation. Synthetic fixtures do not prove production authenticity.

controller_ref.description: External controller responsible for coordinating termination handling.

termination_request_refs.description: Optional termination request references. These do not constitute termination confirmation.

resulting_authority_status.description: The status claimed as the result of a verified revocation.
